reasoning: The PR is completely unrelated to the workaround. The workaround (HACK-008) is a cap on charge amounts to prevent integer overflow in the downstream ledger, pending a migration to bigint columns (PAY-240). There is no evidence that this PR migrates any ledger columns to bigint or removes the amount cap.
